notes:
republika.mk (North Macedonia): 1141 urls, 31/31 days of 2026-09-25..2026-10-25; 09-30=44, 10-10=16, 10-20=38, lowest day 09-27=12.
Route: robots.txt permissive (Yoast block, empty Disallow, /robots.txt 200), then WordPress REST /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&_fields=date,date_gmt,link,content with after=2026-09-24 before=2026-10-26 (one-day buffer), pages 1..28, HTTP 200 on all, 2800 posts walked.
No per-article fetches: content.rendered in the same response carries the body, so the run is 28 requests and 14 s.
Dates = date part of date_gmt (UTC), which is what the pages state (JSON-LD datePublished +00:00; trafilatura reads back the same day). Local 'date' is Skopje time and would land a day early for late-evening posts.
Earlier attempt listed all 2647 in-window posts and failed sample review: photo-of-the-day, video stubs and one-paragraph briefs have under 1500 chars of extractable text (230, 872, 1336 chars measured with trafilatura).
Fix: keep a post only if its stripped article body is >= 1650 chars. trafilatura on the pages gives almost the same length (971 vs 965, 1336 vs 1336, 872 vs 872), so this keeps exactly the pages that read as articles. Re-verified the 6 sample positions the checker picks: 6 of 6 good, 1748-2832 chars, page dates equal to listed dates.
